EX-99.1 2 ex991q326earnings.htm EX-99.1 Document Exhibit 99.1 Veradermics Reports Third Quarter 2026 Financial Results and Highlights Recent Corporate and Clinical Progress Positive topline results from Phase 3 Study ‘304’ and positive 12-month data from Phase 2/3 Study ‘302’ position VDPHL01 to potentially become the first oral treatment to receive FDA approval for pattern hair loss in nearly 30 years Company remains on track to deliver topline data from Phase 2/3 Study ‘306’ evaluating VDPHL01 in female pattern hair loss in 1H27 Positive topline results from open-label Phase 2 Study ‘207’ evaluating VDPHL01 in female pattern hair loss demonstrated rapid onset and consistent hair growth in first ever positive Phase 2 trial for an oral treatment for female pattern hair loss in the U.S.

In men, we reported topline results from two positive registration-directed trials, Studies ‘302’ and ‘304’, which collectively enrolled more than 1,000 male participants and demonstrated early, consistent, and robust hair growth.
We also announced positive topline results from Study ‘302’ Part B, which demonstrated a favorable safety and tolerability profile and achieved deepened or maintained hair growth at 12 months.

In women, we reported positive Phase 2 results in the open-label Study ‘207,’ and completed enrollment in the registration-directed Phase 2/3 Study ‘306,’ with topline data on track for the first half of 2027,” said Reid Waldman, M.D., Chief Executive Officer of Veradermics.

We remain well capitalized to continue the development of VDPHL01 Exhibit 99.1 and advance preparations for a potential commercial launch, with the goal of establishing VDPHL01, if approved, as a foundational treatment for pattern hair loss.” Recent Business Highlights and Upcoming Milestones VDPHL01 Registrational Program for Men and Women with Pattern Hair Loss • Positive Topline Results from 12-Month Data of Phase 2/3 Study ‘302’: In November 2026, Veradermics announced positive topline results from its Phase 2/3 trial, Study ‘302’, evaluating 12-month long-term safety and efficacy of VDPHL01 in males with mild-to-moderate pattern hair loss.

• Positive Topline Results from Phase 3 Study ‘304’ in Male Pattern Hair Loss: In October 2026, Veradermics announced positive topline results from Part A of its Phase 3 trial evaluating the safety and efficacy of VDPHL01 in males with mild-to-moderate pattern hair loss.

• Positive Topline Female Results from Phase 2 Study ‘207’ and Enrollment Complete for Study ‘306’ in Females with Pattern Hair Loss: In July 2026, Veradermics announced positive topline results from its open-label Phase 2 clinical trial Study ‘207’ evaluating VDPHL01 in women with mild-to-moderate pattern hair loss.
The Company expects to report topline data in the first half of 2027.
